recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-7797 follow-up is needed in core unless a future terminology change reintroduces a ValueSet-scoped lookup operation and needs new wording for that distinct operation.
issue_request: FHIR-7797 was a Published FHIR-core ValueSet change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether the Concept look up operation duplicated ValueSet search functionality. The accepted resolution was to add a note explaining the difference between $lookup and value set search.
initial_application: The request was applied in svn revision 5677, represented in git by f4f837eb11b97633e325349bf6fb0b45965e59d6, which added the requested note to the then-ValueSet lookup operation spreadsheet. Later terminology-source refactoring moved the single-concept lookup operation from ValueSet to CodeSystem while preserving the explanatory note in the current CodeSystem lookup OperationDefinition.
additional_context: The current build has active ValueSet, CodeSystem, and OperationDefinition resources in source/fhir.ini, but the active lookup OperationDefinition is CodeSystem-lookup; ValueSet now has expand and validate-code operations, not a current ValueSet-lookup definition. Community searches found no FHIR-7797-specific Zulip or Confluence discussion that changes the source/history conclusion. A later Zulip thread discussed a possible separate bulk ValueSet/$lookup operation, but it did not establish a current core OperationDefinition or undermine the existing CodeSystem $lookup note.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-lookup.xml already contains footer and comment text saying $lookup is more than just a code system search and gathers return information from underlying code system definitions. Adding ValueSet-search wording to the current operation would be stale now that the operation is CodeSystem-scoped.
